_note: Hand-written few-shot example (Req 2.1). Grounded in the real 0300-CMBH-1001 performance steps. Shows the performance_steps -> metrics structure: each metric ties to a step via step_ref, uses a S.P.E.A.R. dimension as the lens, and carries one anchor per tier.

task_attributes.condition: Given an area to observe, with or without the aid of observation devices, while wearing a fighting load.
task_attributes.key_performance_steps: Conduct a hasty search; conduct a detailed search; build a sector sketch; establish a baseline for the pattern of life; maintain observation; record information observed; transmit reports to higher headquarters.

metrics.statement: Speed and coverage of the initial hasty search of the sector.

anchors.Inadequate: Fails to conduct a hasty search or takes excessive time before beginning.
anchors.Satisfactory: Conducts a timely hasty search covering the assigned sector.
anchors.Superior: Rapidly scans the full sector, prioritizing likely threat areas without prompting.

metrics.statement: Thoroughness and accuracy of the detailed search against the baseline.

anchors.Inadequate: Detailed search is cursory and misses anomalies that break the baseline.
anchors.Satisfactory: Detailed search identifies anomalies against the baseline with minor gaps.
anchors.Superior: Systematic detailed search reliably surfaces subtle anomalies across the sector.

metrics.statement: Timeliness and clarity of reports transmitted to higher headquarters.

anchors.Inadequate: Does not transmit reports, or reports are unclear or untimely.
anchors.Satisfactory: Transmits accurate reports to higher headquarters with minor delay.
anchors.Superior: Transmits clear, complete, and timely reports enabling immediate higher action.
